fields.description:
The archive-massgov-pfml checks entry runs the whole jest suite on every agent run, though the comment above it claims only the tests covering the changed page run. A pre-existing date-dependent failure in tests/features/status/PaymentIntroPrepaidCard.test.tsx, unrelated to any agent diff, therefore failed CI for execution intake-f6f13c6b. The repair loop spent 105 LLM calls and 3.2M tokens trying to fix a test the agent never touched, exhausted the budget, and parked the ticket in AWAITING_HUMAN with finished, correct work sitting on the branch.

The platform declares no build-tool convention, so it must not choose a test selector. It should instead tell the project which paths changed and let the declared command decide what to run. Thread the ticket file_impact paths from the workflow into the checks activity and on into the checks pod, expose them to the declared command as a CHANGED_PATHS environment variable, and update the archive-massgov-pfml entry to pass them to jest --findRelatedTests with a full-suite fallback when the variable is empty.

Verified against the promoted branch: jest --findRelatedTests over the five file_impact paths selects exactly the three suites the change affects, all of which pass, and excludes the unrelated failure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ChecksSpec accepts a changed_paths field, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k spec_changed_paths`
- [ ] The checks pod script exports CHANGED_PATHS to the declared command when paths are given, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k exports_changed_paths`
- [ ] The checks pod script omits the export when no paths are given, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k omits_changed_paths`
- [ ] The run_checks activity forwards RunChecksRequest.changed_paths into ChecksSpec, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k forwards_changed_paths`
- [ ] The draft pull request workflow forwards ticket file_impact into RunChecksRequest, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k checks_changed_paths`
- [ ] The archive-massgov-pfml checks command scopes jest to CHANGED_PATHS, checked: reading the --findRelatedTests invocation in config/local/checks.yaml
- [ ] The archive-massgov-pfml checks command falls back to the full suite when CHANGED_PATHS is empty, checked: reading the fallback branch in config/local/checks.yaml

## Testing
Run `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -q` to prove the threading and the export behaviour, then `ruff check .` for lint.
